input.quote: unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term for the applicable Service Option Attachment that it has elected to terminate such Service Option Attachment.
input.rationale: § 3.2 renews each Service Option Attachment automatically but requires ninety (90) days' notice to stop renewal, exceeding our fallback ceiling of a non-renewal notice window of no more than sixty (60) days. Our single operative edit sets the window at sixty (60) days' written notice prior to the end of the then-current term, expressed in both spelled and numeric form so the 60-day figure is unambiguous, and lands the clause at the fallback. No provision permits a renewal price increase; Charges are fixed by the Service Option Attachments and Order Forms (§ 4.1), so the conditional 5 percent uplift element is satisfied on the document's own terms. Preferred-only points noted, not redlined: no 12-month renewal cap, no 30-day opt-out, no Vendor reminder. For the deal team: the mutual sentence means IBM's notice also drops to sixty (60) days, and any Order Form term over 12 months would create an automatic multi-year renewal to escalate.

mappings.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer's non-renewal notice window is no more than 60 days.
If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at 5 percent.
mappings.quote: Charges for applicable Services will be specified in Service Option Attachments and Order Forms.

ops.oldText: notifies the other party in writing at least ninety (90) days prior to the end
ops.newText: gives the other party at least sixty (60) days' written notice prior to the end

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have reduced the § 3.2 non-renewal notice window from ninety (90) to sixty (60) days' written notice so we can exit an automatic renewal within our fallback 60-day window; our preferred position is a 30-day opt-out with a Vendor renewal reminder.
proposal.summary: Reduce the § 3.2 non-renewal notice window to sixty (60) days' written notice.
